learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read and understand easy texts.
Students will be able to write letters with simple sentences and introduce themselves and others.
Students will be able to listen to and understand basic daily conversations; introduce themselves and others with simple sentences and express themselves.
Students will be able to recognize and use basic vocabulary related to daily life.
Students will acquire independent study skills by completing internet assignments given through technology and will be able to access all course materials via Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Developing skills to express oneself with appropriate time structures and articulate daily needs
Reinforcing learned structures through basic reading texts and listening activities
